newTreeNames: Additional lattice models and critical dynamics

entries.name: Su–Schrieffer–Heeger model
entries.distinctBecause: A one-dimensional bond-alternating model, distinct from the Haldane Chern-insulator model and the broader topological-insulator class.

entries.name: Aubry–André quasiperiodic localization model
entries.distinctBecause: A specific noninteracting quasiperiodic model, distinct from random-disorder localization and interacting many-body localization.
entries.yearBasis: 1980 Aubry–André formulation, cited as Ref. 19 in Roati et al. (2008); the experimental source is later.

entries.name: Holstein molecular-crystal / polaron model
entries.distinctBecause: Local electron–phonon coupling is distinct from Hubbard electron repulsion and a two-level spin coupled to a bath.

entries.name: Deconfined quantum criticality
entries.distinctBecause: A framework for critical points, not a claim that a stable spin-liquid phase occurs throughout the neighboring phases.
entries.yearBasis: 2003 public preprint; Science publication followed in 2004.

entries.name: Fracton phases and restricted-mobility frameworks
entries.distinctBecause: Restricted excitation mobility and unusual size-dependent degeneracy distinguish these models from conventional topological-order examples.
entries.yearBasis: 2004 Chamon preprint, published in 2005, used as an explicit precursor anchor rather than a date for the later term fracton.

entries.name: Quantum many-body scar framework
entries.distinctBecause: Special many-body states differ from both single-particle chaotic scars and broadly localized many-body spectra.
entries.yearBasis: 2017 public preprint; Nature Physics publication followed in 2018.

entries.name: Discrete / Floquet time-crystal framework
entries.distinctBecause: A symmetry-breaking phase of driven systems, not all Floquet dynamics or an equilibrium perpetually moving ground state.
entries.yearBasis: 2016 Floquet time-crystal formulation; earlier equilibrium proposals are a different scope.

entries.name: Measurement-induced entanglement transitions
entries.distinctBecause: A transition in monitored dynamics, distinct from using measurements to perform a computation.
entries.yearBasis: 2018 Li–Chen–Fisher hybrid-circuit study; this is a representative early paper, not an exclusive priority claim.

entries.name: Quantum discord framework
entries.distinctBecause: A measure of quantum correlations and measurement disturbance, distinct from an entanglement measure.
entries.yearBasis: 2001 preprint and online journal publication; the journal volume is dated 2002.

entries.name: Resource theory of quantum coherence
entries.distinctBecause: A basis-dependent operational resource theory, distinct from general resource theories and Glauber optical correlation functions.
entries.yearBasis: 2013 public preprint of the Baumgratz–Cramer–Plenio formulation; journal publication followed in 2014.

entries.name: Quantum Zeno effect and dynamics
entries.distinctBecause: A particular dynamical effect of repeated or strong monitoring, rather than the entire continuous-measurement formalism.
entries.yearBasis: 1977 Misra–Sudarshan formulation; earlier short-time survival results are antecedents.

entries.name: Berry phase / adiabatic geometric phase
entries.distinctBecause: A specific adiabatic phase construction, distinct from all geometric formulations of quantum mechanics or any single Hall model.
entries.yearBasis: 1984 Berry formulation; not a claim that all geometric-phase antecedents began in 1984.

entries.name: Aharonov–Bohm effect framework
entries.distinctBecause: A particular gauge-sensitive interference phenomenon within quantum theory, not an alternative to electrodynamics.
entries.yearBasis: 1959 Aharonov–Bohm paper; the entry does not assert the absence of earlier related work.

entries.name: Fano discrete–continuum resonance theory
entries.distinctBecause: A discrete–continuum interference theory, distinct from general configuration interaction and ideal three-level EIT.
entries.yearBasis: 1961 general formulation; Fano’s earlier qualitative work is an antecedent.

entries.name: Operational quantum steering framework
entries.distinctBecause: An operational local-hidden-state criterion, distinct from the original EPR argument and a Bell-local hidden-variable model.
entries.yearBasis: 2006 public preprint of the modern operational definition, published in 2007; the underlying steering idea dates to 1935.

entries.name: Quantum Kibble–Zurek framework
entries.distinctBecause: A framework for finite-rate critical dynamics, distinct from equilibrium criticality and the earlier cosmological or thermal Kibble–Zurek settings.
entries.yearBasis: 2005 Zurek–Dorner–Zoller quantum Ising formulation; not the origin date of the broader Kibble–Zurek mechanism.
